title: Machine learning guides engineering of fluorescent calcium indicators
summary: An ensemble of three regression models trained on experimentally derived GCaMP mutation libraries screened 1,423 uncharacterized variants. The study reports eGCaMP and eGCaMP+ with faster kinetics and larger fluorescence responses than previously published fast variants, and eGCaMP2+ with greater dynamic range than the tested sixth-, seventh- and eighth-generation indicators. The preprint reports cell and neuron assays. These are laboratory sensor results, not human or clinical validation. This is one study; the journal article is a later version.
